notes.cornice: not recoverable from geometry: a street sector's ceiling is the sky, so the top of a facade is painted rather than built, and datums.cornice is null for every candidate
notes.contents: facades[] holds a full record for every campaign multi-opening candidate and for every signed candidate in either population; campaign_candidates[] holds a compact row for every campaign candidate, single-opening runs included, so the distributions can be recomputed. Curated runs that carry no signage appear only in summary: they are precedent, and 15300 full records is not a report.
